digest.component_or_area: backend-neutral core modules (comment processing and inbound translation)
propositions: Neutral core modules outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py contain literal lazy-load keys to jira-specific adapter modules, causing vendor code execution on any backend configuration
Jira rich-text decoding (adf_to_text) and comment truncation (comment_limits) are hard-coded via string keys in neutral paths rather than routed through backend port abstraction
FieldSanitizer and InboundMapper port roles must own comment-fit and rich-text-normalization responsibilities respectively to eliminate vendor-specific literal keys from core
Outbound comment formatting, inbound ADF normalization, and comment-diff decoding must route through the port and execute byte-identically to current behavior after the literal keys are deleted
